title: SentMessage
description: Result of submitting a single message.

status.description: Hubtel request status code (0 = submitted). Other documented values: 1 invalid destination, 2 invalid source, 3 body too long, 4 not routable, 5 invalid delivery time, 6 content rejected, 7 parameter not allowed, 8 parameter invalid, 12 payment required, 100 general invalid request.

clientReference.description: Client reference of the message. Can be null.

statusDescription.description: Brief description of the request status.
